lagrangian.objective_description: weighted material cost plus a penalisation of horizontal displacement on Gamma_D minus a weighted vertical displacement on Gamma_N
lagrangian.objective_description_rationale: summary of the three objective terms.

state_equation.description: thermal state: k grad(T).grad(dT) plus Robin mass term equals Robin data
state_equation.rationale: source thermal equation with Gamma_T resolved to mesh label 3 and the Robin data moved to the right-hand side.

state_equation.description: mechanical state: elasticity bilinear form plus the Dirichlet penalty on Gamma_D equals the vertical body/boundary loads
state_equation.weak_form_rhs: -\int_{label\,2} q(\mathbf e_y\cdot\delta\mathbf u)\,ds - \int_D \rho g\chi(\mathbf e_y\cdot\delta\mathbf u)\,dx
state_equation.rationale: source mechanical equation; load terms moved to the right-hand side with flipped sign, Gamma_D/Gamma_N resolved to labels 4 and 2.

adjoint_equation.description: thermal adjoint: Robin term, conduction term and the thermo-elastic coupling term
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{label\,3}\beta_T\delta T\tilde T\,ds + \int_D k(\nabla\delta T\cdot\nabla\tilde T)\,dx + \int_D(\partial_{(T,\delta T)}\pmb\sigma(\delta T):\pmb\varepsilon(\tilde{\mathbf u})^\top)\,dx
adjoint_equation.rationale: source adjoint with Gamma_T resolved to label 3.

adjoint_equation.description: mechanical adjoint: derivative of J plus Dirichlet penalty plus elasticity term
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{label\,4}\beta(\delta\mathbf u\cdot\tilde{\mathbf u})\,ds + \int_D(\partial_{(\mathbf u,\delta\mathbf u)}\pmb\sigma(\delta\mathbf u):\pmb\varepsilon(\tilde{\mathbf u})^\top)\,dx
adjoint_equation.rationale: source adjoint with the J-derivative moved to the right-hand side.

optimization_config.hmin_rationale: about half the initial element size so thin members stay resolved.
optimization_config.hmax_rationale: about twice the initial element size (mesh is 0.02), fine enough for the 4x1 beam.
optimization_config.diffusion_rationale: small level-set diffusion, standard for a domain of size 4.
optimization_config.v0_rationale: moderate velocity regularisation at the problem's scale.
optimization_config.phi_rationale: horizontal band whose half-thickness is 0.6 at both ends (x = 0 and x = 4) and narrows to 0.2 at mid-span, so the fixed left edge (label 4) and fixed right edge (label 2) are solid along their entire length while the solid fraction stays about 65%.
optimization_config.boundary_labels_rationale: free bottom edge and Robin top edge are movable.
optimization_config.fixed_labels_rationale: clamped left edge and loaded right edge are frozen.
